#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Collect demand and prepare app-tool updates. Never edit automation settings."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import concurrent.futures
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import tomllib
from pathlib import Path

import controller as inventory
import accountability
import maintenance_admission as maintenance
import repo_campaigns

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
STATE = ROOT / "demand-state.json"
PLAN = ROOT / "demand-plan.json"
APP_DB = Path("/Users/teacher/.codex/sqlite/codex-dev.db")
LANES = {k: inventory.TARGETS[k] for k in ("opener", "closer", "orphan", "escalator", "maintenance")}
PROFILES = {"opener": ("gpt-6.1-sol", "high"), "closer": ("gpt-6.1-sol", "medium"),
            "orphan": ("gpt-6.1-sol", "high"), "escalator": ("gpt-6.1-sol", "medium"),
            "maintenance": ("gpt-6.1-sol", "medium")}
STALL_SECONDS = 3 * 3600
STALE_OWNER_SECONDS = 2700  # 45-minute controller round budget
ERROR_FREEZE_MAX_SECONDS = 3600
ISSUE_QUERY = "query($q:String!,$after:String){search(query:$q,type:ISSUE,first:100,after:$after){issueCount pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} nodes{... on Issue{url title number repository{nameWithOwner} author{login __typename} labels(first:30){nodes{name}} body createdAt updatedAt}}}}"
QUERY = """query($q:String!,$after:String){search(query:$q,type:ISSUE,first:100,after:$after){issueCount pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} nodes{... on PullRequest{url title number repository{nameWithOwner} author{login __typename} headRefName headRefOid closingIssuesReferences(first:20){nodes{number repository{nameWithOwner}}} isDraft labels(first:30){nodes{name}} body createdAt updatedAt mergeStateStatus reviewThreads(first:100){pageInfo{hasNextPage} nodes{isResolved isOutdated}} commits(last:1){nodes{commit{committedDate tree{oid} statusCheckRollup{state contexts(first:100){pageInfo{hasNextPage} nodes{... on CheckRun{name status conclusion} ... on StatusContext{context state}}}}}}}}}}}"""


def load(path, default):
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text())
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return default


def save(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, prefix="." + path.name)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as stream:
            json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
            stream.write("\n")
        os.replace(tmp, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.unlink(tmp)


def app_settings():
    with sqlite3.connect(f"file:{APP_DB}?mode=ro", uri=True) as db:
        db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        result = {}
        for lane, path in LANES.items():
            row = db.execute("SELECT status,rrule,model,reasoning_effort FROM automations WHERE id=?", (path.parent.name,)).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                raise RuntimeError("Missing app automation: " + path.parent.name)
            result[lane] = dict(row)
        return result


def signals(pr):
    threads = pr.get("reviewThreads") or {}
    commits = ((pr.get("commits") or {}).get("nodes") or [])
    commit = commits[-1].get("commit", {}) if commits else {}
    rollup = commit.get("statusCheckRollup") or {}
    contexts = rollup.get("contexts") or {}
    nodes = contexts.get("nodes") or []
    failed = any(n.get("conclusion") in {"FAILURE", "CANCELLED", "TIMED_OUT", "ACTION_REQUIRED", "STARTUP_FAILURE"}
                 or n.get("state") in {"FAILURE", "ERROR"} for n in nodes)
    pending = any(n.get("status") in {"QUEUED", "IN_PROGRESS", "WAITING", "PENDING", "REQUESTED"}
                  or n.get("state") == "PENDING" for n in nodes)
    active_threads = sum(not n.get("isResolved") and not n.get("isOutdated") for n in threads.get("nodes", []))
    incomplete = bool((threads.get("pageInfo") or {}).get("hasNextPage") or (contexts.get("pageInfo") or {}).get("hasNextPage"))
    return {"failed": failed, "pending": pending, "threads": active_threads,
            "incomplete": incomplete, "check_state": rollup.get("state", "UNKNOWN"),
            "pushed_at": commit.get("committedDate"),
            "checks": sorted((n.get("name") or n.get("context") or "", n.get("status") or "", n.get("conclusion") or n.get("state") or "") for n in nodes)}


def fingerprint(pr, sig):
    # Ignore discussion timestamps: controller commentary must not manufacture new work.
    value = [pr.get("headRefOid"), pr.get("isDraft"), sorted(inventory.labels(pr)),
             pr.get("body"), pr.get("mergeStateStatus"), sig]
    if pr.get("_continuity_verifier_material") is not None:
        value.append(pr["_continuity_verifier_material"])
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()


def classify(pr, held, challenge, retry, now):
    target = f"{inventory.repo(pr)}#{pr['number']}"
    sig = signals(pr)
    attention = bool(set(inventory.labels(pr)) & {"agent:needs-attention", "autofix:escalated"})
    if target in held:
        return "held", "Confirmed human gate or unexpired scoped blocker", sig
    if target in challenge or target in retry:
        return "escalator", "Challenge unverified human claim or recover expired blocker", sig
    draft_hold = pr.get("isDraft") and re.search(r"keep this pr.*draft|hold:|keep.*draft and unmerged", pr.get("body", ""), re.I)
    if draft_hold and not sig["threads"]:
        return "held", "Explicit draft hold; source evaluation prerequisites remain with their owner", sig
    if pr.get("isDraft") and not attention:
        return "held", "Draft retained until readiness or attention changes", sig
    if not inventory.is_release_pr(pr) and inventory.is_generated_or_durable_pr(pr):
        return "held", "Durable generated publication", sig
    lane = "maintenance" if inventory.maintenance_category(pr) or maintenance.repair_policy(target, maintenance.budget.summary()) else (
        "orphan" if inventory.is_release_pr(pr) or not inventory.is_issue_linked_pr(pr) else "closer")
    if sig["failed"] or sig["threads"] or sig["incomplete"] or attention or pr.get("mergeStateStatus") == "DIRTY":
        return lane, ("Classify existing failures against this shipment; deliver unaffected work and hand off incidental findings; no automatic source repair" if lane == "maintenance" else "Repair failed checks, conflicts, review debt, or diagnose incomplete evidence"), sig
    pushed = inventory.parse_iso(sig["pushed_at"] or "")
    if pushed is not None and now - pushed < 7 * 60:
        return "waiting", "Await exact-head review floor; Luna rechecks readiness", sig
    if sig["pending"]:
        return "waiting", "Await checks; Luna observes completion", sig
    return lane, "Inspect exact-head gates and merge, close, or record a concrete blocker", sig


def pr_owner(pr):
    target = f"{inventory.repo(pr)}#{pr['number']}"
    return "maintenance" if inventory.maintenance_category(pr) or maintenance.repair_policy(target, maintenance.budget.summary()) else (
        "orphan" if inventory.is_release_pr(pr) or not inventory.is_issue_linked_pr(pr) else "closer")


def issue_owner(item):
    receiver = item.get('receiving_lane')
    if receiver in {'opener', 'closer', 'orphan'}:
        return receiver
    return 'closer' if item.get('state') in {'linked-work', 'verifier-follow-up', 'lifecycle-cleanup'} else 'opener'


def build_routes(prs, guard, state, terminal, now, held=set(), challenge=set(), retry=set(), running_lanes=None):
    routes = {k: [] for k in LANES}
    observations = {}
    waits = []
    ignored = []
    prior = state.get("targets", {})
    coverage = terminal.get("coverage_json") or {}
    running_lanes = running_lanes or set()
    if not isinstance(coverage, dict):
        coverage = {}
    for pr in prs:
        target = f"{inventory.repo(pr)}#{pr['number']}"
        lane, action, sig = classify(pr, held, challenge, retry, now)
        fp = fingerprint(pr, sig)
        old = prior.get(target, {})
        since = old.get("unchanged_since", now) if old.get("fingerprint") == fp else now
        row = {"target": target, "head": pr.get("headRefOid"), "fingerprint": fp,
               "action": action, "due": inventory.iso_now(), "lane": lane,
               "delivery_owner": pr_owner(pr), "execution_state": lane if lane in {'held', 'waiting'} else 'active',
               "unchanged_since": since}
        # A terminal result is evidence for this fingerprint, not a timer to repeat diagnosis.
        result = coverage.get(target) or {}
        diagnosed = old.get("diagnosed_fingerprint")
        if result.get("head") == row["head"] and result.get("fingerprint") == fp and result.get("execution_error") is None:
            diagnosed = fp
        if terminal.get("selected_target") == target and terminal.get("execution_error") is None:
            selected = (terminal.get("inventory_evidence") or {}).get("selected") or {}
            if selected.get("head_sha") == row["head"] and terminal.get("completed_at_utc"):
                completed = inventory.parse_iso(terminal["completed_at_utc"])
                # Adopt only a result newer than our observation, or one explicitly fingerprinted.
                if result.get("fingerprint") == fp or (old.get("fingerprint") == fp and completed and completed >= old.get("observed_at", now)):
                    diagnosed = fp
        # Productive recovery can create a real due follow-up; a missed due time
        # must be eligible again even if the PR head has not moved yet.
        due = inventory.parse_iso(result.get("due") or "")
        if result.get("fingerprint") == fp and (
            result.get("execution_error") or
            (result.get("outcome_class") == "productive_recovery" and due is not None and now >= due)
        ):
            diagnosed = None
        row["diagnosed_fingerprint"] = diagnosed
        row["observed_at"] = now
        observations[target] = row
        if lane == "held" or (diagnosed == fp and result.get("park_until_material_change")):
            row['execution_state'] = 'held'
            ignored.append(row)
            continue
        if lane == "escalator":
            if diagnosed != fp:
                routes[lane].append(row)
            else:
                ignored.append(dict(row, action="Diagnosed unchanged blocker; await material evidence"))
            continue
        created = inventory.parse_iso(pr.get("createdAt") or "")
        acquisition_over = created is not None and now - created >= 30 * 60
        receipt = (state.get('lane_receipts') or {}).get(lane) or {}
        stopped_at = inventory.parse_iso(receipt.get('at') or '')
        owner_stopped = (lane in routes and lane not in running_lanes and
                         receipt.get('outcome') == 'no_op' and stopped_at is not None and
                         stopped_at >= since + STALL_SECONDS)
        pending_stuck = lane == 'waiting' and sig['pending'] and now - since >= STALL_SECONDS
        missed_recovery = (result.get('fingerprint') == fp and result.get('outcome_class') == 'productive_recovery'
                           and result.get('action') and due is not None and now >= due and lane not in running_lanes)
        if acquisition_over and diagnosed != fp and (missed_recovery or (now - since >= STALL_SECONDS and (owner_stopped or pending_stuck))):
            routes["escalator"].append(dict(row, lane="escalator", ordinary_lane=lane,
                eligibility_reason='missed_concrete_recovery_deadline' if missed_recovery else ('owner_reported_no_action_after_deadline' if owner_stopped else 'same_pending_checks_observed_for_three_hours'),
                action=('Reconcile the missed concrete recovery: ' + result['action']) if missed_recovery else ("Recover the ordinary owner's documented no-action stall" if owner_stopped else "Diagnose the exact-head checks proven stuck pending for three hours")))
        if lane == "waiting":
            waits.append(row)
        elif lane in routes:
            routes[lane].append(row)
        # Maintenance and its registered repairs keep the same source owner.
    for item in guard.get("actionable_candidates", []):
        lane = issue_owner(item)
        routes[lane].append({"target": f"{item['repository']}#{item['number']}",
            "action": item.get("next_automatic_action") or "Select the next bounded issue action",
            "fingerprint": item.get("updatedAt"), "lane": lane})
    for item in guard.get("challenge_due", []):
        target = f"{item['repository']}#{item['number']}"
        fp = item.get("updatedAt")
        old = prior.get(target, {})
        result = coverage.get(target, {})
        diagnosed = old.get("diagnosed_fingerprint")
        if result.get("fingerprint") == fp and not result.get("execution_error"):
            diagnosed = fp
        row = {"target": target, "fingerprint": fp, "lane": "escalator",
               "action": item.get("next_automatic_action") or "Independently challenge the claimed human blocker",
               "observed_at": now, "diagnosed_fingerprint": diagnosed}
        observations[target] = row
        if diagnosed != fp:
            routes["escalator"].append(row)
    # A scalar-only guard cannot prove absence of actionable candidates.
    if guard.get("actionable_count", 0) and not guard.get("actionable_candidates"):
        routes["opener"].append({"target": "opener-queue", "action": "Reconcile actionable liveness count", "lane": "opener"})
    return routes, observations, waits, ignored


def repair_budget_request(row, policy, node, control):
    """Turn a denied repair into a bounded human decision, not a generic wait."""
    parked = control.get('parked', {}).get(row['target'].lower(), {})
    configured = maintenance.repair_objectives().get(policy['root'], {})
    objective = configured.get('action') if configured.get('head') == (node or {}).get('headRefOid') else None
    current_plan = parked.get('action_plan', {})
    if node:
        try:
            actions = maintenance.validate_action_plan(current_plan, node)
            objective = objective or '; '.join(a.get('description') or a['id'] for a in actions
                                               if a['kind'] == 'engineering' and a['status'] == 'ready')
        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
            pass
    objective = objective or row.get('repair_objective') or row['action']
    request = dict(row, campaign=policy['campaign'], root=policy['root'],
                   head=(node or {}).get('headRefOid'), objective=objective,
                   requested_extra_attempts=0, requested_extra_minutes=0,
                   prerequisite='Prove prior writer terminal; obtain valid new root permit before engineering',
                   completion_criteria='Focused validation and current-head reviewer disposition; complete exact-head delivery gates and actual verifier receipt',
                   human_action=f"Choose whether to retain the known-good component or omit the affected delivery for {policy['root']}: {objective} Further source repair is separate work, not an automatic extension.")
    if node is None:
        # A cached issue/alias is not evidence for another engineering allocation.
        request.update(decision_kind='scope', requested_extra_attempts=0, requested_extra_minutes=0,
            objective='Establish the remaining unmet acceptance criterion and current source PR/head',
            human_action=f"Decide whether {row['target']} still requires source engineering under {policy['root']}: identify the remaining unmet acceptance criterion and current source PR/head, or explicitly narrow/stop the residual. No repair extension is proposed without that evidence.")
    else:
        request['decision_kind'] = 'delivery_scope'
    binding = {key: request[key] for key in ('campaign', 'root', 'head', 'objective',
                'requested_extra_attempts', 'requested_extra_minutes')}
    request['request_id'] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(binding, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
    return request


def budget_alerts(decisions, state, now):
    prepared = state.get('repair_budget_alerts', {})
    for row in decisions:
        previous = prepared.get(row['request_id'])
        row['new_alert_due'] = previous is None or now - previous >= accountability.REMINDER_SECONDS
    return decisions


def maintenance_admissions(prs, routes, observations, waits, control, view, now):
    """Apply the same source budget to every lane; successor PRs cannot reset it."""
    nodes = {maintenance.identity(node): node for node in prs}
    objectives = maintenance.repair_objectives()
    decisions = []
    maintenance_waiting = False
    for lane in routes:
        admitted = []
        for row in routes[lane]:
            target = row['target'].lower()
            node = nodes.get(target)
            policy = maintenance.repair_policy(target, view)
            if policy and (policy.get('owner_directed_task') or {}).get('completed_at'):
                waits.append(dict(row, execution_state='owner-task-complete',
                    action='Named owner task completed; do not revive it or request budget'))
                continue
            if (policy and policy['campaign'] in control.get('retired_campaigns', {})
                    and not policy.get('owner_directed_task')
                    and not (node and inventory.maintenance_category(node))):
                waits.append(dict(row, execution_state='closed-campaign',
                    action='Closed sync campaign residual; retain repository owner, no maintenance repair or budget alert'))
                continue
            if policy:
                row.update(work_category='sync-delivery-triage', campaign=policy['campaign'],
                           root=policy['root'], budget_status=policy['status'],
                           owner='Sol maintenance delivery worker',
                           action='Assess concrete shipment impact from existing evidence; continue eligible delivery, hand off incidental findings, and do not launch source engineering without separate finite scope authorization')
            if policy and policy.get('owner_directed_task'):
                row.update(work_category='owner-directed-repair',
                    owner='Established finite task owner; preserve exact live-writer ownership',
                    action=policy['owner_directed_task']['objective'])
            scoped = maintenance.action_eligibility(target, node, dict(control, _open_targets=list(nodes), _now=now), policy) if node else None
            if scoped is not None:
                maintenance_waiting = True  # scoped observation is not permission for a weekly inventory
                row.update(scoped)
                row['work_category'] = 'action-scoped-maintenance'
                # A historical root objective cannot override a current action disposition.
                for key in ('dependency', 'confidence', 'resumption_condition'):
                    row.pop(key, None)
            # Observation is controller-owned data reconciliation, never a generic
            # coding-worker assignment. Metadata alone cannot sandbox an LLM.
            if scoped is not None and scoped.get('eligible_actions') == ['observe']:
                row.update(execution_state='controller-observation', lane='controller',
                           observed_obligations=sorted(maintenance.observed_obligations(node)),
                           check_evidence=signals(node)['checks'])
                waits.append(row)
                if row['target'] in observations: observations[row['target']].update(row)
                continue
            reason = None
            if node and (lane == 'maintenance' or policy):
                reason = maintenance.decision(target, node, nodes, signals(node), control, view, now)
            elif policy and (policy['status'] == 'exhausted' or policy['active_permits']):
                reason = ('Repair budget exhausted; human must narrow, stop, or explicitly extend ' + policy['campaign']) if policy['status'] == 'exhausted' else 'Existing admitted repair owner holds this root'
            if reason:
                if lane == 'maintenance' or policy:
                    maintenance_waiting = True
                waiting = dict(row, action=reason, execution_state='waiting')
                waits.append(waiting)
                if row['target'] in observations:
                    observations[row['target']].update(action=reason, execution_state='waiting')
                if policy and policy['status'] == 'exhausted' and not policy['active_permits']:
                    decisions.append(repair_budget_request(dict(waiting, repair_objective=row['action']), policy, node, control))
            else:
                admitted.append(row)
        routes[lane] = admitted
    routes['maintenance'].sort(key=lambda row: row.get('priority', '0 - routine delivery'))
    follow_up = maintenance.service_assignment(control, now)
    # An overdue weekly timer cannot bypass the target-level parking decision.
    # Explicit due workflow follow-ups retain their separate compare-and-ack path.
    if (follow_up and not routes['maintenance'] and
            not (follow_up['eligibility_reason'] == 'weekly_service_due' and maintenance_waiting)):
        routes['maintenance'].append(follow_up)
    return list({row['request_id']: row for row in decisions}.values())


def repo_maintenance_admissions(routes, waits, control, view, writer, now, running_owners=None):
    """Extend only the existing maintenance lane; native lanes retain ownership."""
    result = repo_campaigns.controller_plan(ROOT / 'repo-campaigns.json', control, view, writer, now,
        sync_critical_pending=bool(routes['maintenance'] or any(row.get('root') for row in waits)
                                  or any(running_owners or {})), running_owners=running_owners,
        policy_path=ROOT / 'repo-campaign-policy.json', intake_path=ROOT / 'owner-intake-hold.json')
    routes['maintenance'].extend(result['assignments'])
    return result


def reconcile_ownership(prs, issues, guard, routes, observations, now):
    """Give each delivery item a verified path; repair missing handoffs by target.

    A linked open PR can cover an issue while its owner waits on checks or an
    approved hold. A disposition without that PR or a receiving assignment
    cannot cover it. Reconciliation is concrete work on a current delivery item,
    independent of its age or deadline.
    """
    ownership, repairs = {}, []
    assigned = {row['target']: (lane, row) for lane, rows in routes.items() for row in rows}
    classified = {}
    for key in ['candidates', 'dispositioned_candidates', 'linked_work', 'automation_retry',
                'actionable_candidates', 'challenge_due', 'human_attention']:
        for item in guard.get(key, []):
            classified[f"{item['repository']}#{item['number']}"] = item
    linked = {}
    budget_view = maintenance.budget.summary()
    issue_ids = {accountability.identity(node).lower(): accountability.identity(node) for node in issues}
    for node in prs:
        target = accountability.identity(node)
        observed = observations[target]
        ownership[target] = {'owner': observed['delivery_owner'], 'state': observed['execution_state'],
                             'action': observed['action'], 'via': []}
        for source in accountability.issue_links(node):
            linked.setdefault(source, []).append(target)
        policy = maintenance.repair_policy(target, budget_view)
        if policy and policy['root'] in issue_ids and policy['root'] != target.lower():
            source = issue_ids[policy['root']]
            if target not in linked.setdefault(source, []):
                linked[source].append(target)
    for node in issues:
        if not accountability.delivery_issue(node):
            continue
        target = accountability.identity(node)
        item = classified.get(target, {})
        if item.get('state') == 'human-input-required' or item in guard.get('human_attention', []):
            owned = {'owner': 'opener', 'state': 'human-wait', 'via': [],
                     'action': item.get('next_automatic_action') or 'Resume implementation after the confirmed input arrives',
                     'resume_condition': item.get('human_action') or 'Supply the documented human input'}
        elif target in linked and (target not in assigned or item.get('state') == 'linked-work'
                                  or maintenance.repair_policy(target, budget_view)):
            # Luna has already reconciled this PR in the complete inventory.
            # A linked recheck timer cannot turn pending checks into Sol work.
            if target in assigned:
                lane, _ = assigned.pop(target)
                routes[lane] = [row for row in routes[lane] if row['target'] != target]
            via = linked[target]
            states = [ownership[pr]['state'] for pr in via]
            chosen = next((pr for pr in via if ownership[pr]['state'] == 'active'), via[0])
            owned = {'owner': ownership[chosen]['owner'], 'state': 'active' if 'active' in states else (
                     'waiting' if 'waiting' in states else ownership[chosen]['state']),
                     'action': 'Follow the linked PR owner through merge, verification and source closure', 'via': via}
        elif target in assigned:
            lane, row = assigned[target]
            owned = {'owner': lane, 'state': 'active', 'action': row['action'], 'via': []}
        elif item.get('state') == 'automation-retry' and (
                inventory.parse_iso((item.get('blocker') or {}).get('expires_at') or '') or 0) > now:
            owned = {'owner': 'opener', 'state': 'retry-wait', 'via': [],
                     'action': item['next_automatic_action'], 'resume_at': item['blocker']['expires_at']}
        else:
            lane = issue_owner(item)
            reason = 'linked_issue_without_current_pr_coverage' if item.get('state') == 'linked-work' else 'delivery_issue_without_verified_owner'
            action = item.get('next_automatic_action') or (
                'Reconcile this open delivery issue: verify its supported owner, perform bounded remaining work '
                'or safe closure, or record a confirmed human gate with a resumption condition')
            row = {'target': target, 'lane': lane, 'action': action,
                   'fingerprint': node.get('updatedAt'), 'eligibility_reason': reason}
            routes[lane].append(row)
            assigned[target] = (lane, row)
            repairs.append(target)
            owned = {'owner': lane, 'state': 'active', 'action': action, 'via': []}
        ownership[target] = owned
        observations[target] = {'target': target, 'lane': owned['owner'], 'delivery_owner': owned['owner'],
                                'execution_state': owned['state'], 'fingerprint': node.get('updatedAt'),
                                'action': owned['action'], 'observed_at': now}
    return ownership, repairs


def ownership_gaps(records, ownership, routes, observations):
    assigned = {}
    for lane, rows in routes.items():
        for row in rows:
            assigned.setdefault(row['target'], {})[lane] = row
    def assignment_matches(target, owner):
        lanes = assigned.get(target, {})
        escalation = lanes.get('escalator') or {}
        return owner in lanes or bool(escalation) and (
            (observations.get(target) or {}).get('lane') == 'escalator'
            or escalation.get('ordinary_lane') == owner)
    gaps = []
    for target, record in records.items():
        row = ownership.get(target) or {}
        state, owner = row.get('state'), row.get('owner')
        via = row.get('via') or []
        covered = owner in {*LANES, 'maintenance'} and bool(row.get('action'))
        if state == 'active':
            covered = covered and (assignment_matches(target, owner)
                                  or bool(via) and all(pr in observations for pr in via)
                                  and any(assignment_matches(pr, owner) for pr in via))
        elif state in {'waiting', 'held', 'maintenance', 'controller-observation'}:
            covered = covered and (bool(via) and all(pr in observations for pr in via)
                                  or record['kind'] == 'pr' and target in observations
                                  and observations[target].get('execution_state') == state
                                  and observations[target].get('delivery_owner') == owner)
        elif state == 'repair-wait':
            policy = maintenance.repair_policy(target, maintenance.budget.summary())
            covered = covered and bool(policy) and (policy['status'] == 'exhausted' or bool(policy['active_permits']))
        elif state == 'human-wait':
            covered = covered and bool(row.get('resume_condition'))
        elif state == 'retry-wait':
            covered = covered and inventory.parse_iso(row.get('resume_at') or '') is not None
        else:
            covered = False
        if not covered:
            gaps.append(target)
    return sorted(gaps)


def desired_settings(routes, actual, errors, running_owners=None):
    # Owner correction 2026-10-16: restore demand-based starts. Pausing future
    # starts does not cancel an incumbent or discard its existing assignment.
    desired = {}
    maintenance_owner = maintenance.existing_worker() if not errors else None
    for lane in LANES:
        model, effort = PROFILES[lane]
        current = actual[lane]
        rrule = current.get("rrule", inventory.RRULES[lane + "_active"])
        if errors:
            status = current['status']  # Incomplete discovery cannot prove idle.
        else:
            owners = (running_owners or {}).get(lane, [])
            owner = (any(row.get('classification') != 'stale' for row in owners) or
                     (lane == 'maintenance' and maintenance_owner))
            status = 'ACTIVE' if routes[lane] and not owner else 'PAUSED'
            # Owner closeout correction 2026-10-22: maintenance returns to
            # enabled weekly service after delivery, rather than staying on
            # the campaign recovery cadence. Preserve live/unknown owners.
            if lane == 'maintenance' and not owner:
                delivery_due = any(row.get('target') != 'weekly-sync-inventory'
                                   for row in routes[lane])
                status = 'ACTIVE'
                rrule = inventory.RRULES['maintenance_active' if delivery_due
                                        else 'maintenance_dormant']
        desired[lane] = {"status": status,
                         "rrule": rrule,
                         "model": current.get("model", model),
                         "reasoning_effort": current.get("reasoning_effort", effort)}
    return desired


def ownership_coverage_warnings(gaps):
    """A missing owner is actionable, but does not invalidate the inventory."""
    return (['Delivery ownership coverage missing: ' + ', '.join(gaps)] if gaps else [])


def error_freeze(errors, state, now):
    """Track a stable blocking-error set without letting it freeze lanes forever."""
    error_set = sorted(set(errors))
    previous = state.get('error_freeze', {})
    first_seen = previous.get('first_seen') if previous.get('errors') == error_set else now
    if not isinstance(first_seen, (int, float)):
        first_seen = now
    elapsed = max(0, int(now - first_seen))
    return {'errors': error_set, 'first_seen': first_seen, 'elapsed_seconds': elapsed,
            'lapsed': bool(error_set) and elapsed > ERROR_FREEZE_MAX_SECONDS}


def error_freeze_message(freeze):
    errors = freeze['errors']
    if not errors:
        return 'not active; errors=[]'
    if freeze['lapsed']:
        return f"lapsed after {freeze['elapsed_seconds']}s; errors={errors}"
    return f"active for {freeze['elapsed_seconds']}s; errors={errors}"


def frozen_lanes_message(freeze):
    if not freeze['errors'] or freeze['lapsed']:
        return 'lanes frozen by errors: 0 (drainable when: now)'
    lapse_at = int(freeze['first_seen'] + ERROR_FREEZE_MAX_SECONDS)
    return f'lanes frozen by errors: {len(LANES)} (drainable when: lapse at {lapse_at})'


def thread_process_alive(thread_id):
    """Return whether a live process command line names this Codex thread."""
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(['ps', '-axo', 'command'], check=False, capture_output=True,
                                text=True, timeout=5)
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        return False
    return result.returncode == 0 and any(thread_id in command for command in result.stdout.splitlines())


def running_lane_owners(lanes, app_db=APP_DB, state_db=Path.home() / '.codex/state_5.sqlite', now=None):
    """Read exact scheduled owners; do not infer ownership from legacy mutex PID/age."""
    if not lanes:
        return {}
    result = {}
    now = time.time() if now is None else now
    with sqlite3.connect(Path(app_db).resolve().as_uri() + '?mode=ro', uri=True) as app:
        rows = [(lane, row[0]) for lane in lanes for row in app.execute(
            "SELECT thread_id FROM automation_runs WHERE automation_id=? AND status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','RUNNING')",
            (LANES[lane].parent.name,))]
    try:
        state = sqlite3.connect(Path(state_db).resolve().as_uri() + '?mode=ro', uri=True)
    except sqlite3.Error:
        state = None
    try:
        for lane, thread in rows:
            owner = {'automation_id': LANES[lane].parent.name, 'thread_id': thread,
                     'turn_id': None, 'probe': 'UNKNOWN'}
            result.setdefault(lane, []).append(owner)
            try:
                row = state.execute('SELECT rollout_path FROM threads WHERE id=?', (thread,)).fetchone() if state else None
                if not row:
                    raise ValueError('Exact automation thread rollout unavailable')
                path = Path(row[0])
                owner['rollout_path'] = str(path)
                owner['rollout_age_seconds'] = max(0, now - path.stat().st_mtime)
                with path.open('rb') as stream:
                    header = json.loads(stream.readline())
                    if header.get('type') != 'session_meta' or header.get('payload', {}).get('id') != thread:
                        raise ValueError('Automation thread/rollout identity mismatch')
                    size = stream.seek(0, 2)
                    start = max(0, size - 512 * 1024)
                    stream.seek(start)
                    raw = stream.read()
                if not raw.endswith(b'\n'):
                    raise ValueError('Rollout tail is partially written')
                records = raw.splitlines()[1:] if start else raw.splitlines()
                terminal = False
                for raw_line in records:
                    event = json.loads(raw_line)
                    payload = event.get('payload', {})
                    if event.get('type') != 'event_msg':
                        continue
                    if payload.get('type') == 'task_started':
                        owner['turn_id'] = payload.get('turn_id')
                        terminal = False
                    elif (payload.get('type') in ('task_complete', 'turn_aborted') and
                          payload.get('turn_id') == owner['turn_id']):
                        terminal = True
                if not owner['turn_id']:
                    raise ValueError('Exact active turn not found in bounded rollout tail')
                if terminal:
                    raise ValueError('App run still active but exact turn is terminal; await reconciliation')
                owner.update(probe='HELD', reason='App automation run active and exact turn has no terminal event')
            except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, sqlite3.Error) as exc:
                owner['reason'] = str(exc)
            owner['process_alive'] = thread_process_alive(thread)
            if owner['probe'] == 'HELD':
                owner['classification'] = 'live'
                owner['liveness_reason'] = 'active_turn'
            elif owner.get('rollout_age_seconds', float('inf')) <= STALE_OWNER_SECONDS:
                owner['classification'] = 'live'
                owner['liveness_reason'] = 'recent_rollout'
            elif owner['process_alive']:
                owner['classification'] = 'live'
                owner['liveness_reason'] = 'thread_process'
            else:
                owner['classification'] = 'stale'
                owner['stale_reason'] = owner.get('reason', 'No active turn, recent rollout, or thread process')
    finally:
        if state:
            state.close()
    return result


def running_lanes():
    with sqlite3.connect(f'file:{APP_DB}?mode=ro', uri=True) as db:
        return {lane for lane, path in LANES.items() if db.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM automation_runs WHERE automation_id=? AND status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','RUNNING') LIMIT 1",
            (path.parent.name,)).fetchone()}


def write_operational_memory(plan):
    # App automations preload this file; persist the corrected demand policy.
    summary = {k: plan.get(k) for k in ['generated_at', 'errors', 'desired', 'accountability_count']}
    summary['eligible_route_counts'] = {k: len(v) for k, v in plan['routes'].items()}
    text = ('# Current demand controller contract\n\n'
            'Owner correction 2026-10-16: restore demand-based scheduling. Workers without eligible work are PAUSED; eligible work reactivates starts when no equivalent live owner exists. '
            'Incomplete discovery preserves actual settings and last complete assignments. A HELD or UNKNOWN owner suppresses duplicate scheduled starts without cancelling current work. '
            'Preserve same-lane mutexes, item-scoped human gates, repository exclusions and existing cadence/model/notification preferences. '
            'The seven-day human deadline remains independent of worker activation. '
            'Use demand-plan.json for current eligibility and app-readback.json for persisted settings. '
            'The plan below is proposed state until app readback verifies it. Historical notes are archived and are not policy.\n\n'
            + json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')
    (ROOT / 'memory.md').write_text(text)


def update_args(lane, desired):
    config = tomllib.loads(LANES[lane].read_text())
    target = config.get("target") or {}
    model = desired.get('model', config['model'])
    effort = desired.get('reasoning_effort', config['reasoning_effort'])
    return {"mode": "update", "id": config["id"], "kind": "cron", "name": config["name"],
        "prompt": config["prompt"], "rrule": desired["rrule"], "status": desired["status"],
        "model": model, "reasoningEffort": effort, "executionEnvironment": "local",
        "projectId": target.get("project_id"), "notificationPolicy": config.get("notification_policy")}


def relay_eligible(lane):
    assignment = load(ROOT / (lane + "-assignment.json"), {})
    generated = inventory.parse_iso(assignment.get("generated_at") or "")
    return bool(generated and time.time() - generated <= 2 * 3600 and
                assignment.get("targets") and not assignment.get("errors"))


def collect():
    inventory.RUN_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    query = "user:stranske is:open archived:false -repo:stranske/Collab-Admin -repo:stranske/Collab-Deliverables"
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
        pr_future = pool.submit(inventory.gh_graphql, QUERY, query + " is:pr", inventory.RUN_DIR / "demand-prs.json")
        issue_future = pool.submit(inventory.gh_graphql, ISSUE_QUERY, query + " is:issue", inventory.RUN_DIR / "demand-issues.json")
        guard_future = pool.submit(inventory.run_json, ["/Users/teacher/.codex/bin/opener-liveness-guard.py", "--json"], 100)
        prs, pr_error = pr_future.result()
        issues, issue_error = issue_future.result()
        guard, guard_error = guard_future.result()
    errors = [e for e in [pr_error, issue_error, guard_error] if e]
    if guard and guard.get("error_count"):
        errors.append("Incomplete liveness inventory: " + str(guard.get("errors")))
    if not prs or not prs.get("complete"):
        errors.append("PR inventory incomplete")
    if not issues or not issues.get("complete"):
        errors.append("Issue inventory incomplete")
    return prs, issues, guard, errors


def followthrough_context(plan):
    """Return the requested target's existing inventory evidence without another query."""
    path = ROOT / 'followthrough-request.json'
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    try:
        request = json.loads(path.read_text())
        target = request['target']
        import followthrough_control
        capacity = followthrough_control.capacity_context(request)
        context = {key: request.get(key) for key in (
            'status', 'target', 'expected_head', 'criteria', 'requested_at',
            'review_due_at', 'capacity_review_due_at', 'capacity_collected_at', 'merge_sha', 'merged_at',
            'cycle_reported_at', 'review_reported_at')}
        matches = []
        groups = [*plan.get('routes', {}).values(), plan.get('waiting', []), plan.get('held', [])]
        for group in groups:
            for row in group:
                if row.get('target', '').casefold() == target.casefold():
                    matches.append({key: row.get(key) for key in (
                        'target', 'head', 'lane', 'delivery_owner', 'execution_state', 'action', 'due')})
        context.update(capacity)
        context['inventory_matches'] = matches
        context['inventory_disposition'] = 'PRESENT' if matches else 'ABSENT_REQUIRES_STATE_READ'
        context['errors'] = []
        return context
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError) as exc:
        return {'errors': [f'Follow-through context unavailable: {exc}']}


# pinned delivery-continuity hook
import importlib.util as _continuity_import
_CONTINUITY_PATH = '/Users/teacher/.codex/automations/reviewed-repo-automation-controller/delivery-continuity-a1720a1d8e922529db556ecd989792d5410e85d6ef627e385584f20b9b1cd40e.py'
_CONTINUITY_SHA256 = 'a1720a1d8e922529db556ecd989792d5410e85d6ef627e385584f20b9b1cd40e'


def _continuity_module():
    path = Path(_CONTINUITY_PATH)
    if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != _CONTINUITY_SHA256:
        raise RuntimeError("delivery continuity source changed; retain canonical assignment")
    spec = _continuity_import.spec_from_file_location("_pinned_delivery_continuity", path)
    module = _continuity_import.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def _continuity_held(state, reason):
    original = state.get("delivery_continuity", {})
    carry = dict(original) if isinstance(original, dict) else original
    targets = state.get("targets", {})
    targets = targets if isinstance(targets, dict) else {}
    ownership_state = state.get("delivery_ownership", {})
    ownership_state = ownership_state if isinstance(ownership_state, dict) else {}
    if isinstance(carry, dict):
        for target, row in targets.items():
            if isinstance(row, dict) and row.get("head") and isinstance(row.get("delivery_owner"), str) and row.get("delivery_owner") in {"closer", "orphan", "maintenance"}:
                carry.setdefault(target, {"target": target, "pr_target": row.get("pr_target"), "owner": row["delivery_owner"]})
    rows, ownership = [], {}
    for target, raw in (carry.items() if isinstance(carry, dict) else []):
        old = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
        known = ownership_state.get(target, {})
        known = known if isinstance(known, dict) else {}
        owner = old.get("owner")
        if not isinstance(owner, str):
            owner = known.get("owner")
        if isinstance(target, str) and "#" in target and isinstance(owner, str) and owner in {"closer", "orphan", "maintenance"}:
            rows.append({"target": target, "lane": owner, "delivery_owner": owner,
                         "execution_state": "held", "action": "Continuity integrity wait: " + reason})
            ownership[target] = {"owner": owner, "state": "held", "via": [], "action": rows[-1]["action"]}
    return {"rows": rows, "ownership": ownership, "carry": carry}

def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--event", choices=["issue-active"])
    parser.add_argument("--source", default="manual")
    parser.add_argument("--update-args", choices=list(LANES))
    parser.add_argument("--verify", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--verify-and-observe", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--relay-eligible", choices=["opener", "closer"])
    parser.add_argument("--record-human-alert", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.relay_eligible:
        return 0 if relay_eligible(args.relay_eligible) else 1
    if args.update_args:
        plan = load(PLAN, {})
        if time.time() - plan.get("created_at", 0) > 10 * 60:
            raise RuntimeError("Plan expired; collect fresh evidence before updating")
        print(json.dumps(update_args(args.update_args, plan["desired"][args.update_args])))
        return 0
    if args.verify or args.verify_and_observe:
        plan = load(PLAN, {})
        if set(plan.get('desired', {})) != set(LANES) or time.time() - plan.get('created_at', 0) > 10 * 60:
            raise RuntimeError('Missing or expired five-lane plan; cannot claim activation verification')
        actual = app_settings()
        mismatches = {k: {"expected": v, "actual": actual[k]} for k, v in plan.get("desired", {}).items()
                      if any(actual[k].get(field) != value for field, value in v.items())}
        save(ROOT / "app-readback.json", {"verified_at": inventory.iso_now(), "actual": actual, "mismatches": mismatches})
        if args.verify_and_observe:
            import followthrough_observer
            observation = followthrough_observer.observe()
            compact = {'observed_at': observation['observed_at'], 'errors': observation['errors'],
                       'lanes': {lane: {
                           'actual_status': row['actual_status'],
                           'pause_disposition': row['pause_disposition'],
                           'run_start_count': row['run_start_count'],
                           'activation_status': row['actual_activation_then_run']['status'],
                           'completed_cycle_count': len(row['actual_activation_then_run'].get('completed_cycles', []))
                       } for lane, row in observation['lanes'].items()}}
            context = followthrough_context(plan)
            print(json.dumps({'verified': not mismatches, 'mismatches': mismatches,
                              'observation': compact, 'followthrough': context}))
            return int(bool(mismatches or observation['errors'] or
                            context and context.get('errors')))
        print(json.dumps({"verified": not mismatches, "mismatches": mismatches, "actual": actual}))
        return int(bool(mismatches))
    with (ROOT / ".demand.lock").open("a") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        state = load(STATE, {})
        if args.record_human_alert:
            plan = load(PLAN, {})
            if time.time() - plan.get("created_at", 0) > 10 * 60:
                raise RuntimeError("Alert plan expired")
            alerts = [r for r in plan.get('human_deadline_due', []) if r.get('new_alert_due') and
                      time.time() - ((state.get('accountability') or {}).get(r['target']) or {}).get('last_human_alert_at', 0) >= accountability.REMINDER_SECONDS]
            for row in alerts:
                entry = (state.get('accountability') or {}).get(row['target'])
                if entry and entry.get('episode') == row['episode']:
                    entry['last_human_alert_at'] = time.time()
            repair_alerts = [r for r in plan.get('repair_budget_decisions', [])
                             if r.get('new_alert_due') and (r['request_id'] not in state.get('repair_budget_alerts', {}) or
                             time.time() - state['repair_budget_alerts'][r['request_id']] >= accountability.REMINDER_SECONDS)]
            for row in repair_alerts:
                state.setdefault('repair_budget_alerts', {})[row['request_id']] = time.time()
            alerts.extend(repair_alerts)
            if alerts:
                save(ROOT / 'human-alert-latest.json', {'prepared_at': inventory.iso_now(), 'items': alerts,
                    'instruction': 'Present these exact targets and human actions in the final controller response. This record is not proof of notification delivery.'})
            save(STATE, state)
            print(json.dumps({'prepared_human_alert_count': len(alerts), 'artifact': str(ROOT / 'human-alert-latest.json')}))
            return 0
        if args.event:
            # Postrun records progress; schedule authority stays with the Luna controller.
            state["last_progress_event"] = {"at": inventory.iso_now(), "source": args.source[:500]}
            lane = re.search(r'\blane=(opener|closer)\b', args.source)
            outcome = re.search(r'\boutcome=([a-z_]+)\b', args.source)
            if lane and outcome:
                state.setdefault('lane_receipts', {})[lane.group(1)] = {
                    'at': inventory.iso_now(), 'outcome': outcome.group(1), 'source': args.source[:500]}
            save(STATE, state)
            print(json.dumps({"mode": "event", "recorded": True, "schedule_changes": 0}))
            return 0
        actual = app_settings()
        prs, issues, guard, errors = collect()
        warnings = []
        now = time.time()
        held, challenge, retry = inventory.scoped_blocker_states()
        terminal = load(inventory.ROOT / "reviewed-repo-stall-escalator/memory.md", {})
        running = running_lanes()
        running_owners = running_lane_owners(running)
        stale_lane_owners = {lane: [owner for owner in owners if owner.get('classification') == 'stale']
                             for lane, owners in running_owners.items()}
        stale_lane_owners = {lane: owners for lane, owners in stale_lane_owners.items() if owners}
        live_running_owners = {lane: [owner for owner in owners if owner.get('classification') != 'stale']
                               for lane, owners in running_owners.items()}
        live_running_owners = {lane: owners for lane, owners in live_running_owners.items() if owners}
        continuity = None
        if not errors:
            try:
                continuity = _continuity_module().prepare_controller(
                    __import__(__name__), state, prs, now, terminal, (held, challenge, retry))
                warnings.extend("Delivery continuity " + failure["target"] + ": " + failure["reason"]
                                for failure in continuity.get("failures", []))
            except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError, RuntimeError) as exc:
                warnings.append("Delivery continuity held: " + str(exc))
                continuity = _continuity_held(state, str(exc))
        routes, observations, waits, ignored = build_routes(
            (prs or {}).get("nodes", []), guard or {}, state, terminal, now, held, challenge, retry, running)
        budget_decisions = []
        ownership, ownership_repairs = {}, []
        if not errors:
            ownership, ownership_repairs = reconcile_ownership(
                prs['nodes'], issues['nodes'], guard or {}, routes, observations, now)
            try:
                view = maintenance.budget.summary()
                budget_decisions = maintenance_admissions(prs['nodes'], routes, observations, waits,
                    maintenance.read_control(), view, now)
                for row in waits:
                    target = row['target']
                    if target not in ownership:
                        continue
                    state_name = ('controller-observation' if row.get('execution_state') == 'controller-observation' else
                                  'waiting' if target.lower() in {maintenance.identity(n) for n in prs['nodes']} else 'repair-wait')
                    ownership[target].update(state=state_name, action=row['action'])
                    observations[target].update(execution_state=state_name, action=row['action'])
                for target, owned in ownership.items():
                    via = owned.get('via') or []
                    if via and all(ownership[p]['state'] != 'active' for p in via):
                        owned.update(state=ownership[via[0]]['state'], action=ownership[via[0]]['action'])
                        observations[target].update(execution_state=owned['state'], action=owned['action'])
            except (ValueError, OSError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
                errors.append('Maintenance admission unavailable: ' + str(exc))
        if not errors and continuity is not None:
            try:
                _continuity_module().merge_plan(continuity, routes, observations, ownership, waits)
            except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError, RuntimeError) as exc:
                warnings.append("Delivery continuity held: " + str(exc))
                continuity = _continuity_held(state, str(exc))
                for row in continuity["rows"]:
                    if row["target"] not in observations:
                        waits.append(row)
                        observations[row["target"]] = row
                        ownership[row["target"]] = continuity["ownership"][row["target"]]
        records, recoveries, human_due, exclusions = accountability.evaluate(
            (prs or {}).get('nodes', []), (issues or {}).get('nodes', []), guard or {},
            state.get('accountability', {}), terminal.get('coverage_json') or {}, observations, now)
        gaps = ownership_gaps(records, ownership, routes, observations) if not errors else []
        warnings.extend(ownership_coverage_warnings(gaps))
        if errors:
            human_due = accountability.unknown_due(state.get('accountability', {}), now,
                                                  state.get('last_complete_at'), errors)
        # Annotate real work with deadline context. The ledger never invents
        # Sol work from age, uncertainty, a draft, or a human-only hold.
        for row in routes['escalator']:
            record = records.get(row['target'])
            if record:
                row.update(accountability_episode=record['episode'], kind=record['kind'], human_due_at=record['human_due_at'])
        routes['escalator'].sort(key=lambda r: (r.get('human_due_at', now + accountability.HUMAN_SECONDS), r['target']))
        # Incomplete discovery never deactivates a lane or wakes Sol just to retry discovery.
        repo_maintenance = {'assignments': [], 'errors': []}
        if not errors:
            try:
                repo_maintenance = repo_maintenance_admissions(routes, waits,
                    maintenance.read_control(), view, maintenance.existing_worker(), now, live_running_owners)
            except (ValueError, OSError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
                errors.append('Repo maintenance planning unavailable: ' + str(exc))
        freeze = error_freeze(errors, state, now)
        effective_errors = [] if freeze['lapsed'] else errors
        desired = desired_settings(routes, actual, effective_errors, live_running_owners)
        updates = [lane for lane in LANES if any(actual[lane].get(k) != v for k, v in desired[lane].items())]
        plan = {"created_at": now, "generated_at": inventory.iso_now(), "errors": errors,
                "warnings": warnings, "error_freeze": error_freeze_message(freeze),
                "lanes_frozen_by_errors": frozen_lanes_message(freeze),
                "desired": desired, "updates": updates, "routes": routes, "waiting": waits,
                "held": ignored, "pr_count": (prs or {}).get("issueCount"),
                "issue_count": (issues or {}).get('issueCount'),
                "accountability_policy": {'recovery_hours': 3, 'human_after_days': 7, 'reminder_hours': 24},
                "accountability_count": len(records), "deadline_exclusions": exclusions,
                "human_deadline_due": human_due,
                "human_deadline_notification_required": any(r['new_alert_due'] for r in human_due),
                "guard_counts": {k: v for k, v in (guard or {}).items() if isinstance(v, (int, bool))},
                "human_attention": (guard or {}).get("human_attention_samples", [])}
        budget_alerts(budget_decisions, state, now)
        plan['repo_maintenance'] = repo_maintenance
        plan['repair_budget_decisions'] = budget_decisions
        plan['repair_budget_notification_required'] = any(r['new_alert_due'] for r in budget_decisions)
        plan['maintenance_running_owner'] = maintenance.existing_worker()
        plan['running_lane_owners'] = live_running_owners
        plan['stale_lane_owners'] = stale_lane_owners
        plan.update(delivery_ownership=ownership if not errors else state.get('delivery_ownership', {}),
                    ownership_complete=not errors, ownership_gap_targets=gaps,
                    ownership_repaired_targets=ownership_repairs if not errors else [],
                    ownership_snapshot_at=plan['generated_at'] if not errors else state.get('last_complete_at'))
        save(PLAN, plan)
        write_operational_memory(plan)
        # Workers read their bounded assignment rather than repeat controller discovery.
        if not errors:
            for lane, rows in routes.items():
                save(ROOT / (lane + "-assignment.json"), {"generated_at": plan["generated_at"],
                    "model": desired[lane]["model"], "reasoning_effort": desired[lane]["reasoning_effort"],
                    "targets": rows, "errors": errors})
            if continuity is not None:
                state["delivery_continuity"] = continuity["carry"]
                state["delivery_continuity_failures"] = continuity.get(
                    "failures", state.get("delivery_continuity_failures", []))
            state["targets"] = observations
            state['accountability'] = records
            state['delivery_ownership'] = ownership
            state["last_complete_at"] = plan["generated_at"]
            state.pop('error_freeze', None)
            save(STATE, state)
        else:
            state['error_freeze'] = {'errors': freeze['errors'], 'first_seen': freeze['first_seen']}
            save(STATE, state)
        compact = {k: plan[k] for k in ["generated_at", "errors", "warnings", "error_freeze",
                   "lanes_frozen_by_errors", "updates", "desired", "pr_count", "guard_counts"]}
        compact["route_counts"] = {k: len(v) for k, v in routes.items()}
        compact["waiting_count"] = len(waits)
        compact["held_count"] = len(ignored)
        compact["plan_path"] = str(PLAN)
        compact['accountability_count'] = len(records) if not errors else None
        compact['human_deadline_overdue_count'] = len(human_due) if not errors else None
        compact['human_deadline_notification_required'] = plan['human_deadline_notification_required']
        compact['human_deadline_alert_path'] = str(PLAN)
        compact['accountability_policy'] = plan['accountability_policy']
        compact['ownership_complete'] = plan['ownership_complete']
        compact['ownership_gap_count'] = len(gaps) if not errors else None
        compact['ownership_repaired_targets'] = plan['ownership_repaired_targets']
        compact['repair_budget_decisions'] = budget_decisions
        compact['repair_budget_notification_required'] = plan['repair_budget_notification_required']
        compact['maintenance_running_owner'] = plan['maintenance_running_owner']
        compact['running_lane_owners'] = live_running_owners
        compact['stale_lane_owners'] = stale_lane_owners
        compact['running_lane_owner_count'] = sum(len(owners) for owners in live_running_owners.values())
        compact['stale_lane_owner_count'] = sum(len(owners) for owners in stale_lane_owners.values())
        print(json.dumps(compact), flush=True)
        with (ROOT / "demand-ledger.jsonl").open("a") as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(compact) + "\n")
        return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
